description: List all opened documents in Hopper. A document represents a file being disassembled. Returns an array of strings, each being the name of an opened document.
name: list_documents

description: Returns the name of the document that currently has the focus in the GUI.
name: current_document

description: Select the default document for this MCP bridge. Does not activate Hopper or change its key window.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

name: set_current_document

description: List all segments of the specified document. Returns an array of objects, each containing the segment name, its start address ("start"), end address ("end"), and boolean flags indicating if it is writable and/or executable. The "section" property contains an array of sections, each described by its name, start address, and end address.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

name: list_segments

description: List all procedures (also known as functions) in the specified document, along with their entry point addresses. Returns an object mapping hexadecimal addresses to procedure names. The list is usually very large; use the "search_procedures" tool to find specific procedures.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

name: list_procedures

description: List basic information for all procedures (also known as functions) in the specified document. Returns a dictionary where each key is a procedure entry point, and the value is another dictionary containing the procedure name, the number of basic blocks, and its size in bytes.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

name: list_procedure_size

description: List all information regarding procedures in the specified document. Returns a dictionary where keys are procedure addresses, and values are detailed procedure descriptions. Each description contains the procedure name (if any), its entry point address ("entrypoint"), the number of basic blocks ("basic_block_count"), an array of basic block descriptions ("basic_blocks"), and the total length in bytes ("length"). Each basic block description contains its start and end addresses ("from" and "to", with the end address included). If available, the procedure signature is provided as a C-like function signature ("signature"). Local variables are listed in the "locals" array, each containing a name and its stack displacement.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

name: list_procedure_info

description: List all strings defined in the specified document along with their addresses. Returns an object mapping addresses to string values. The list is usually very large; use the "search_strings" tool to find specific strings.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

name: list_strings

description: Search for strings in the specified document by filtering all strings using a regular expression. Returns an object mapping addresses of found strings to their values.

case_sensitive.description: A boolean indicating if the regular expression should be case sensitive.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

pattern.description: A regular expression used to filter the strings.

name: search_strings

description: Search for procedures in the specified document by filtering procedure names using a regular expression. Returns an object mapping addresses of found procedures to their names.

case_sensitive.description: A boolean indicating if the regular expression should be case sensitive.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

pattern.description: A regular expression used to filter the procedure names.

name: search_procedures

description: Get detailed information about a specific procedure in the specified document. This tool can also be used to find a procedure by its exact name or address. Procedures are also called functions. Returns a dictionary containing the procedure name (if any), its entry point address ("entrypoint"), the number of basic blocks ("basic_block_count"), an array of basic block descriptions ("basic_blocks"), and the total length in bytes ("length"). Each basic block description contains its start and end addresses ("from" and "to", with the end address included). If available, the procedure signature is provided as a C-like function signature ("signature"). Local variables are listed in the "locals" array, each containing a name and its stack displacement.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

procedure.description: The name or address of the procedure. Leave unset for the current procedure.

name: procedure_info

description: Find the entry point of a given procedure in the specified document by its name, or by any hexadecimal address within the procedure.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

procedure.description: The name of the procedure, or any address within it as a hexadecimal number.

name: procedure_address

description: Get the current cursor address in the specified document. Returns a hexadecimal number.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

name: current_address

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

name: current_procedure

description: Move the cursor to a given address in the specified document, which will become the current address.

address.description: The address in hexadecimal, or a label name.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

name: goto_address

description: Disassemble and generate the assembly code for a procedure in the specified document. Returns a string containing the assembly code of the procedure.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

procedure.description: The name or address of the procedure as a hexadecimal number. Leave unset for the current procedure.

name: procedure_assembly

description: Decompile a procedure in the specified document into a C-like pseudo-code representation. This helps in understanding the logic of the procedure. Note that generating pseudo-code may take a very long time for complex procedures with many basic blocks. It is recommended to limit the use of this tool to procedures with fewer than fifty basic blocks.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

procedure.description: The name or address of the procedure. Leave unset for the current procedure.

name: procedure_pseudo_code

procedure.description: The name or address of the procedure. Leave unset for the current procedure.

name: procedure_callers

description: List all procedures called by a given procedure in the specified document. Returns a list of names of the procedures that the specified one calls.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

procedure.description: The name or address of the procedure. Leave unset for the current procedure.

name: procedure_callees

description: List all addresses referencing a given address in the specified document. Returns a list of addresses in hexadecimal notation that reference the specified address. Each address corresponds to an instruction that jumps to the requested address.

document.description: Exact name from list_documents, or a document reference from list_document_objects.

name: xrefs

case_sensitive.description: A boolean indicating if the regular expression should be case sensitive.
